_about: Strings of the Routines section. The shared route list is translated in the core catalogue (routes.*).
quickstart.title: Routines
quickstart.about: Routine work by scenario, not by alphabet: go through the steps top to bottom. Steps marked «human» are not run by the panel — that is work for you or the assistant. Scenarios live in cockpit/scenarios.txt and are edited as plain text.
quickstart.outcome: The outcome: the base is filled with cards from the sources and put in order. New cards arrive as drafts — trust is not assigned to them, kb:trust computes it from the statuses of related tasks. While tasks are in progress the trusted share stays low, and that is normal.
